items.title: 10.8 Emf par asar karne wale awamil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.8 (PDF 243) with a table and self-checks.

blocks.text: 1. Magnetic flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah
Faraday ka qanoon batata hai ke magnetic flux jitni tezi se badle, induced emf utni zyada hoti hai (ε = −NΔϕ/Δt mein Δt chhota to emf bari).
Faraday ke qanoon ke mutabiq induced emf coil ke turns ki tadaad ke bhi proportional hai: turns dogune to emf dogni. Zyada turns, zyada induced emf.
Magnetic field mein coil (ya conductor) ki speed bhi induced emf ki miqdar par asar karti hai. Tez speed se flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah barhti hai, aur is se induced emf barh jati hai.

blocks.caption: Induced emf par asar karne wale awamil
rows: Coil aur magnet ki nisbati speed

blocks.prompt: 0.2 T field mein chalti dhaati rod ke siron par 0.8 V emf hai; baqi sab wahi rakh kar 2.4 V ke liye kitni field chahiye (numerical 10.4)? 4.0 cm radius aur 1.0 milliohm resistance wala copper chhalla perpendicular field mein hai jo 5 × 10⁻³ s mein 0.2 T se 0.4 T ho jati hai; current nikalein (numerical 10.5).
Faraday ka qanoon aur Lenz ka qanoon bayan aur wazeh kijiye, aur induced emf par asar karne wale awamil (factors) bataiye (comprehensive question 10.3).
blocks.explanation: Faraday ka qanoon: N loops wali coil mein induced ausat emf us se magnetic flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah ke manfi ke barabar hai, ε = −NΔϕ/Δt. Lenz ka qanoon: induced current hamesha us tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karta hai jis ne use paida kiya; isi liye minus ki alamat hai aur isi liye electrical energy banane ke liye kaam karna parta hai. Emf flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah, turns ki tadaad aur coil aur magnet ki nisbati speed ke saath barhti hai.

items: Induced emf barhti hai (1) flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah, (2) turns ki tadaad (proportional) aur (3) field mein coil ya conductor ki nisbati speed ke saath.
